summary: Technical Architect review approved feedback iteration 1 for the Registration intake. Source review confirms the six planned stories are represented end to end: Auth.js/NextAuth is configured with Google and GitHub providers using the required environment variable names; handlers are exposed at /api/auth/[...nextauth]; Prisma/PostgreSQL persistence defines User, Account, Session, and VerificationToken with provider-account uniqueness and cascade deletes; database session strategy is enabled; /sign-in provides customer-scoped Google/GitHub actions and safe OAuth error copy; functional coverage verifies provider visibility, safe error rendering, and provider discovery. Non-browser checks run in this review passed: `npm.cmd ls next-auth @auth/core @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, and `npm.cmd run lint`. Browser tests were not launched inside this task per instruction; controller-owned Playwright evidence shows passed with code 0, 3 expected tests, 0 unexpected, 0 skipped, and no stderr in `.ai_factory/tests/reports/local-runner/39f5ce65-09f2-47a4-ab0e-8efc47cd0c1c/delivery-1-test-1-a0b546d6-cc3e-49c5-8760-8900068812de.json`. No delivery blockers or application defects were found.
